slugGrammar.shape: <core>-for-sale-wellfleet-ma[-N]/ ; core is the POS product name slugified at post creation

coreLayouts.typeFirst: <type tokens>-<brand or house abbreviation>-<strain/name>-<strain type>-<size> e.g. flower-popcorn-half-ounce-claravita-maui-waui-sdh-14g

slugGrammar.duplicateCounter: -N after -for-sale-wellfleet-ma is the WordPress duplicate-slug counter (654 slugs); the same title can map to several slugs (sizes or re-imports)
slugGrammar.nonAscii: 36 slugs contain percent-encoded UTF-8 (e.g. 1-%c2%bc = 1-1/4 sign); the static host must serve the decoded directory name

images.isImgixEvidence: x-imgix-id response header on every variant; live pages already use ?auto=format&fit=fill&fill=solid&ixlib=react-9.5.4&h=330&w=344 (audit/raw/event-strane-garcia-hellavated-do-drops-pop-up.html)
findings: Accepted params: w, h, fit=fill, fill=solid, fm=webp, fm=avif, auto=format (negotiates AVIF for an Accept header listing image/avif), q, dpr (w=200&dpr=2 returned 400x400).

The sample source is only 250x250 JPEG (13,668 bytes); imgix upscales on request (w=1000 returned 1000x1000, 60,497 bytes) so PDP sizes above the source add bytes, not detail. Source sizes of the other products are UNVERIFIED.

estimates.method: sample bytes x 5857 products; ONE image measured, so these are order-of-magnitude only (many products may share or lack images)

images.recommendation: Hotlink images.dutchie.com with imgix params instead of downloading (CORS *, max-age 1 year): cards ?auto=format&fit=fill&fill=solid&w=344&h=330 (+ dpr=2 srcset), PDP ?auto=format&w=<min(source,800)>. Self-host only the brand/category art. Plan B has an image for t1 only.
